messages.subject: Expected values
parts:
Hello Everyone, I was trying to calculate the "rate" and "expected"  values of "cases" for the sample given data frame as follows in r using the formula " rj = ∑n i=1 yij ∑n i=1 Popij " and " Ei = ∑ J j=1 Popij × rj "  which is taken from a book " Spatial and Spatio-temporal Bayesian Models with R-INLA " chapter 6 Disease mapping. unfortunately, even though I  believe for my self , somebody who is next to God for my task do not agree with my work. 
I'm not sure and doubt it is right or not here is the r-code and the result. somebody who is next to God for my task do not agree with my work. any body who show  me my fault it's my great pleasure and I attached here the r code that I tried. 
county population cases
Autauga 55200 9315474
Baldwin 208107 32510022
Barbour 25782 3371247
Bibb         22527 3771403
Blount         57645 8907065

#Calculate the sum_cases: ∑ni=1 yij
sum_cases <- sum(Covid_Alab$cases)
# Calculate the sum_population: ∑ni=1 Popij
sum_population <- sum(Covid_Alab$population)
# Calculate the ratio ∑ni=1 yij / ∑ni=1 Popij for each county
county_ratios <- numeric(length(Covid_Alab$county))
for (i in 1:length(Covid_Alab$county)) {
  county_ratios[i] <- sum(Covid_Alab$cases) / sum(Covid_Alab$population)
}
# Calculate rj for each county
Covid_Alab$ratio <- (sum_cases / sum_population)

# Calculate Ei = ∑Jj=1 Popij × ratio for each county
Covid_Alab$Ei <- sum_population * Covid_Alab$ratio 
county      population cases         ratio                           Ei

Baldwin 208107      32510022 156.4945616 761295964
Barbour 25782      3371247         156.4945616 761295964
Bibb        22527     3771403          156.4945616 761295964
Blount       57645      8907065          156.4945616 761295964

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Expected values
parts:
The expected counts in area i are calculated as

Expected_i = Population_i * SumCasesAllAreas/SumPopulationAllAreas

replace the last line of code

by

Covid_Alab$Ei <- Covid_Alab$population* Covid_Alab$ratio


Best,
Paula
